The three modules compiled here import nothing with I/O: `lib/study-session.ts` imports nothing at all, `lib/session-resolver.ts` adds only `lib/study-session.ts`, and `lib/session-reaping.ts` adds only those two. That is what makes the six-state machine, the two-tab race and the cross-device resume provable with no Supabase project in reach (U.3, the determinism boundary) — the race in particular, because a race is only testable when the test can control both racers.
